stem:
Anil brings the north end of one bar near the north end of another.

What happens?

options.text: They attract, because any two magnets always pull together.
They repel: like poles push apart.
Nothing happens unless a compass is watching.
They attract only if both bars are red.

teacher.key_rationale: Like poles repel. Attraction of unlike poles is the other case. Colour and a watching compass are not required.
